prompt: pacemaker colocation constraint resource template rsc with-rsc restriction
answer:
In a Pacemaker `rsc_colocation` constraint, a resource template may be referenced by either `rsc` or `with-rsc`, but **only one of them may be a template**; the other must be a regular resource.

```xml
<rsc_colocation
    id="vm-template-colo-base-rsc"
    rsc="vm-template"
    rsc-role="Started"
    with-rsc="base-rsc"
    score="INFINITY"/>
```

This applies the constraint to all primitive resources derived from `vm-template`. A template cannot be used simultaneously for both `rsc` and `with-rsc`.  
Source: [Pacemaker 1.1 — Referencing Templates in Constraints](https://clusterlabs.org/projects/pacemaker/doc/deprecated/en-US/Pacemaker/1.1/html/Pacemaker_Explained/_referencing_templates_in_constraints.html)
